name: inner-page-head
label: Page title with lead
description: The opening of an inner page: a big serif title and a larger serif lead sentence, at the original site's line lengths.

defaults.lead: It is not just a handout. Your gift pays for the meals, and for the people who help someone find a way home.
defaults.title: Help us keep showing up.

css:
.ph__t { margin: 0 0 .4em; max-width: 15ch; font-family: var(--os-font-heading); font-weight: 400; font-size: clamp(2.6rem, 1.2rem + 5.2vw, 5.2rem); line-height: 1; letter-spacing: -0.025em; color: var(--os-color-heading); text-wrap: balance; }
.ph__l { margin: 0 0 1em; max-width: 34ch; font-family: var(--os-font-heading); font-size: clamp(1.5rem, 1rem + 1.8vw, 2.3rem); line-height: 1.25; letter-spacing: -0.01em; color: var(--os-color-heading); text-wrap: balance; }

ai.purpose: The title and lead at the top of an inner page.
ai.whenToUse: First section of every inner page.
